Petal & Stem is a new merchant with no cost data, so the policy's conservative default cost basis applies: 2.10% of volume + $0.12 per transaction. At list price, the merchant's $32,000 monthly volume and 900 transactions give revenue of $1,105 against a cost of $780. That is a 29.41% margin, which is below the 31% minimum for small merchants.
